card: Adds detailed debug and trace logging for compact block reconstruction and GETBLOCKTXN responses, recording counts and byte sizes for transactions obtained from prefills, the mempool, the extrapool, and peer requests. It tracks redundant prefilled transactions against local pools, decouples extrapool counting from mempool counting, and logs complete lists of missing transaction IDs at trace level instead of suppressing output when five or more transactions are missing. This improves observability into compact block reconstruction performance and was split out to assist evaluation of prefilling compact blocks in PR 35558.
changed_since_previous: Minor updates from rebase; no substantive changes to the approach or scope.
evidence: PR description: 'Split from #35558, this makes it easier to observe compact block reconstruction performance by: - At debuglevel=trace logging all missing TX's in a CMPCTBLOCK, and all missing TX's requested from us. - Logging the sizes and counts of tx's used from the prefill, mempool, and extrapool. - Logging the sizes and sources of redundant transactions in the prefill section of received CMPCTBLOCKs.'

Commit a6cc3f30ef: 'It doesn't make that much sense to log here only when there's a few transactions, since either a user is interested in what tx'es caused reconstruction to fail or they aren't, so log all txid's and make this a trace-level log message.'
problem: Evaluating compact block reconstruction efficiency is difficult because existing logs do not report transaction byte sizes or prefill redundancy, and extrapool hits were conflated with mempool matches. Furthermore, missing transaction IDs are suppressed whenever five or more transactions are missing, obscuring the cause of reconstruction round-trips.

risk.why: A bug in PartiallyDownloadedBlock reconstruction accounting or pool scanning could cause compact block reconstruction failures, leading to unnecessary GETBLOCKTXN round-trips and delayed block propagation.

summary: Expands compact block logging during block reconstruction and when serving GETBLOCKTXN requests. At debug level BCLog::CMPCTBLOCK, it records counts and byte sizes of transactions obtained from prefills, the mempool, the extrapool, and peer requests, while tracking redundant prefilled transactions. At trace level, it logs complete lists of missing transaction IDs. It also separates the reconstruction match counter from logging-specific counters, decoupling extrapool matches from mempool counts.
